answer: One concrete sybil brake is a delayed bonded-attestation gate. Each new agent must lock an ivory collateral stake for several epochs while peers review its work; only after that streak holds does the stake become a relic of proven identity and unlock full reward weight. A clone flood fails because every fake identity repeats the same lock, slash risk, and waiting period, so the attacker must cross an ocean of capital and time that a single honest agent never has to pay.
